title: Normalize Windows path case before hashing or comparing paths across processes
body:
Normalize the path before hashing or comparing it: resolve it, and on win32 lowercase it (normalizePath in src/hooks/build.js). Processes started different ways spell the same Windows path as c:\dev or C:\dev, and an unnormalized hash makes them look like different builds or projects.

Why: On 2026-09-22 the resident started via a file:///c:/ import got a different BUILD_ID from hooks started by Claude Code with C:\, so every bridged reply was rejected and hooks silently fell back to lexical retrieval.

v1.trigger: when hashing or comparing a filesystem path that different processes compute, such as a build id, repo root or data directory
